prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE complete Tower Defense map concept named CELESTIAL VOID (PURPLE). Input 1 is the strict route geometry reference; input 2 is a visual style reference from Celestial Islands. Keep the five horizontal road lanes and four alternating right/left/right/left vertical connections, one continuous unbranched zig-zag from SPAWN at upper left to BASE at bottom right. Preserve landscape aspect ratio 1038:800 and comparable road width and spacing. Strict top-down 2D gameplay plane, no tilted perspective. Evolve the celestial fantasy reference into a PURPLE VOID theme: muted deep amethyst and plum buildable terrain, lavender moonstone bridge-path with restrained silver/gold edging and small violet celestial runes, dark purple cosmic void with soft violet mist and sparse stars only at the outer perimeter. Floating island silhouette and fractured moonstone perimeter edges, but NO holes in the buildable interior. Sparse small lavender crystals, tiny floating rock fragments, a few graceful lunar ruins, purple-leaved shrubs. Broad uncluttered flat placement regions between road lanes; ground must remain darker and less bright than the road. Path clearly outlined and easy to read; avoid saturated neon-magenta lava or sci-fi metal. Magical, serene, mysterious celestial fantasy rather than aggressive dark nova. Spawn is a compact violet-silver moon portal; Base is a cream/gold celestial sanctuary with an amethyst crystal. Endpoints stay fully inside the canvas. Polished cartoon game illustration compatible with wooden fantasy Archer Towers; readable silhouettes, restrained bloom. No towers, monsters, HUD, sidebar, UI frame, option lettering or title. Only small SPAWN and BASE labels beside their respective platforms. This is a full map selection mockup, not a tileset or gameplay implementation.
